providers.subtitle: Manage Claude Code / Desktop third-party API configs and switch with one click

providers.routingModeHint: Independent mode writes the current provider. Unified catalog merges every provider through the local proxy; pick models in the CLI with /model.
providers.catalogSubagentHint: Writes CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL for Explore and other background tasks. Leave empty to use the current default model.
providers.catalogSubagentHintCodex: Codex requests with an x-openai-subagent header are rewritten to this model. Leave empty to use the current default. Independent mode still uses the per-provider auto-review override only.
providers.catalogSubagentPlaceholder: Pick from the catalog or leave empty
providers.catalogHideOfficialHint: Do not inject luna/sol/terra, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.5, or similar picker suggestions into the catalog. Client requests for those ids are rewritten to the subagent or current default. A provider’s own saved default is kept.
providers.visibleModelsHint: Unchecked ids stay out of /model and live catalogs. The default model cannot be hidden. Failover may still use a hidden id.
providers.catalogModeDescription: Saving writes every provider’s models through the local proxy. Pick models inside Claude Code / Codex with /model — no “set current” on this page. Claude Code discovery only keeps ids containing claude or anthropic, so other models appear as claude.{provider}.{model}. Restoring official login turns this mode off.
providers.defaultPermissionModeHint: Writes permissions.defaultMode in ~/.claude/settings.json (Shift+Tab: Manual / Plan / Accept edits / Auto). Applies to new conversations only; a folder-remembered mode may override this. On Windows, Plan sometimes needs one extra toggle at session start.

providers.opencodeSubtitle: Manages direct model providers for OpenCode CLI / Desktop (~/.config/opencode). Save to write opencode.json — no switch needed; pick models inside OpenCode.

providers.dshNoSwitchTitle: DSH does not need provider switching
providers.dshNoSwitchDescription: Creating, editing, or importing a provider writes ~/.dsh/settings.yaml and ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml. Select models directly in Harness UI or CLI; connects directly to upstream endpoints without a local proxy.

proxy.title: Local proxy
proxy.description: Day-to-day upstream changes happen on Providers; the local proxy starts and stops automatically when needed. Use this page only to change the port, force a restart, or tune failover.
proxy.subtitleFor: Port, start/stop, and failover ops for {{client}}
proxy.statusUnavailable: Proxy status is unavailable. Refresh to try again.
proxy.failoverDescription: When enabled, network or retryable upstream errors try backup providers by group and list order (up to 3 hops). Two consecutive failures open that provider's circuit for 60 seconds. Disabled by default.
proxy.failoverGroupHint: Priority: lower group first, then provider list order. Configure group and model allowlist in the provider editor.
proxy.hotSwitchDescription: In proxy mode, switching the current provider on the Providers page applies on the next request—no visit here required. If the CLI is not pointed at the local proxy (direct mode), in-process env may still need a CLI restart.
proxy.portRunningHint: Stop the proxy before changing the listen port.
proxy.retryCodesTitle: HTTP status codes that trigger retry
proxy.retryCodesHint: Retryable HTTP status codes (ranges like 400-404 are allowed, comma-separated)
proxy.idleTimeoutHint: Streaming idle timeout in seconds. Forwarding stops if no data arrives within this window.
proxy.opencodeDirectHint: OpenCode connects directly to each protocol endpoint via the AI SDK (baseURL + API key) and does not use the local proxy; switch its configuration on the Providers page.
proxy.piDirectHint: Pi writes a custom provider into models.json (default model + failover list). It has no Claude Sonnet/Opus/Haiku role mapping.
proxy.dshDirectHint: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) writes custom providers to settings.yaml and .credentials.yaml without Claude’s Sonnet/Opus/Haiku role mapping.

usage.description: Request, token, and estimated-cost data from local-proxy logs. Codex / Claude Code / OpenCode / Pi can also sync local sessions. Direct upstream traffic has no live proxy rows—use Sync sessions to backfill.

about.title: About
about.description: View this app's version and updates.
about.appOnlyDescription: View this app's version and current-release notes, check for updates, and restore onboarding tips. Agent tools are under Settings → Agent tools.
about.changelogEmpty: No release notes are bundled for this build.

1_3_23: Antigravity gateway limiter: waiting for a concurrency slot no longer bypasses the gate; deadlines return 429 and outbound network failures return 504 instead of 502.
1_3_24: Cline support: local proxy on :15827, usage from proxy logs, sessions from ~/.cline, and workspace MCP / Prompts / Skills.
Antigravity gateway Wave 1: local short-circuit for background Claude requests, thinkingBudget from budget_tokens, and short same-account RetryInfo.
Local proxy executes Anthropic web_search / web_fetch; Claude / Codex saves can sync into WSL.
Environment page can upload and restore the library ZIP over WebDAV; localization tracks upstream latest (Desktop pack 1.4.6).
About shows this release’s notes in the UI language; the local proxy page uses the same single-column cards as other settings pages.
1_3_25: Providers: Qianfan Token Plan presets, Kimi reasoning_effort, ModelScope/Novita top-level enable_thinking, and StepFun effort mapping.
Gateway: keep Anthropic native server-tool prefixes and subagent headers; drop Codex prompt_cache_retention; isolate compact/client errors from account cooldown.
Usage: persist stream_outcome (complete / cancelled / mid-stream); filter logs to failures only.
Accounts: switch 5-hour vs 7-day quota views; custom HTTP headers on providers.
Antigravity: rotate accounts by Gemini vs Claude family; background short-circuit toggles now have descriptions. Windows Codex CLI probe uses the anchored Node first.
1_3_26: Sessions: configurable local backup directory, with full ZIP backup and one-click restore for Claude Code / Codex / Pi / DSH (OpenCode / Cline still have no file-archive backup).
1_4_0: Claude Code providers: set a default work mode for new chats (Manual / Plan / Accept edits / Auto), written to permissions.defaultMode in settings.json.
Sessions: scheduled full ZIP and change-mirror backups are independent switches, with an active window and 8 auto packs per Agent; restore missing files from the mirror or overwrite the Agent.
GitHub Releases now list per-platform download links (Chinese notes first).
1_4_1: Fix Windows session backup: the \\?\ prefix from canonicalize made opening the backup folder fail and full ZIP report an invalid relative path.
1_4_2: Provider cards show official subscription usage and vendor balances / coding-plan windows (Kimi, Zhipu, MiniMax, DeepSeek, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter, and others), with a manual refresh.
Self-hosted sub2api gateways are probed via GET /v1/usage for wallet balance or daily/weekly/monthly limits (not NewAPI /api/user/self).
Antigravity account pool: short cooldown and clear sticky session accounts on upstream timeouts, instead of treating a blip as a full-pool failure.

antigravity.title: Reverse Proxy Gateway
antigravity.personalUseNotice: Personal-use gateway only. Review upstream terms yourself; do not operate as a commercial relay.
antigravity.outboundHint: Outbound proxy for Google / Cloud Code. In China use Clash SOCKS5 (default socks5://127.0.0.1:17891), not http://; overseas can choose Direct.
antigravity.modelsEmpty: No model catalog yet. Sign in and click Refresh quota.
antigravity.modelsHint: Refreshing quota syncs live Antigravity models; /v1/models and provider binding use this list. Gemini Flash ids are gemini-3.7-flash and gemini-3.6-flash (both stay listed; neither is rewritten onto the other). In Claude Desktop, use role routing (name=claude-sonnet-5 + labelOverride=gemini-3.7-flash) to select 3.7. For Codex, re-run Ensure Provider — protocol is openai_responses (/v1/responses).
antigravity.importOptional: Optional: paste account JSON exported from Antigravity-Manager if you already have it.
antigravity.howToAddOauth: Recommended: click “Sign in with Google in browser”, finish Google consent, and the account will show up in the list.
antigravity.howToAddNotIde: Note: signing into the Antigravity website/IDE does not sync into this app. You must click “Sign in with Google in browser” here.
antigravity.howToAddJson: Browsers do not generate refresh_token JSON by themselves. You only get JSON after OAuth login here or an export from Antigravity-Manager.
antigravity.oauthLogin: Sign in with Google in browser
antigravity.reauthorizeHint: Use Sign in with Google in browser at the top of this page to authorize the same email again.
antigravity.emptyAccounts: No accounts yet. Sign in with Google, or import JSON.
antigravity.bindNeedsAccount: Add at least one account before binding apps.
antigravity.quotaNeedsProject: Cloud Code project is not ready yet; 5h/7d quota bars appear after it is assigned. Refresh quotas to retry.
antigravity.setActiveDone: Set as active. The gateway will prefer this account for new requests.
antigravity.bindAppsHint: One-click create/update the built-in Antigravity provider (pointing at the local gateway) for each app. It only adds the provider — switch it manually on the Providers page.
antigravity.providerReadyForTarget: Built-in Antigravity provider created/updated for {{target}} — switch it on the Providers page
antigravity.limiterHint: Per-account in-flight caps and request pacing. A full slot or retry deadline returns 429 instead of bypassing the gate. Takes effect immediately after save (active streams keep their slots).
antigravity.limiterRateOffHint: Set RPM cap to 0 to disable the token bucket (concurrency gates and 429 backoff still apply).
antigravity.fastPathHint: Claude Code also sends short helper requests (quota probe, session title, command prefix). When checked, the gateway answers locally instead of using Cloud Code quota; when unchecked, they go upstream as usual.
antigravity.fastPathQuotaHint: Startup sends a quota check. When on, reply locally with a pass.
antigravity.fastPathTitleSkipHint: Sidebar titles normally call a model. When on, reply locally with Conversation.
antigravity.fastPathPrefixHint: Terminal command safety check (injection, dangerous commands). When on, parse and reply locally.
antigravity.fastPathFlashHint: Helper tasks that were not short-circuited (summary, compression) use cheap Gemini Flash instead of the main model.
antigravity.fastPathSuggestionHint: Skip Claude Code next-step suggestions. Off by default: a false match can swallow a real reply.
antigravity.fastPathFilepathHint: Extract file paths from command output. Off by default: a false match can drop paths.
antigravity.rotationHint: Prefers the active account; rotates on failure by health and quota
